headline: Healthy quarter; Launch heavy 2HFY27

highlights: Maintain ‘BUY’ rating and DCF-derived NAV with SOTP-based TP of INR 1,800/share. ~2% YoY EBITDA growth: Operationally, PEPL reported EBITDA of INR 9.3bn vs.
For H1, the EBITDA stood at INR 17.9bn (declined by 1% YoY), with OPM at 37.7%.
Annuity income during the quarter stood at INR 2.4bn, up 11% YoY.
PEPL’s unrecognised revenue stood at INR 756bn, with Bengaluru accounting for the largest share (44%).

In MMR, management will focus on projects with ticket sizes of >INR20mn, while targeting lower ticket sizes in other markets, supported by relatively lower land costs. • New launches guidance: Q2FY27 launches: Launch pipeline of over INR 460bn planned across Bangalore, Mumbai, NCR, Chennai, Goa and Hyderabad over the next two quarters.

Q3FY27 launches include five projects across Thane (Falcon City), Noida (Bougainvillea Gardens), Bangalore (Avon and Springwood) and Goa (Prestige Sea Scapes), subject to RERA approvals, with ~INR200bn of launches targeted in Q3.
